title: DPP claim selection, version 1
description: The claims one release or one declaration requires of the ledger (spec/conformance.md section 6): each claim named required or withheld with its kind, and every row that carries a required system or product claim's profile but is not required by the claim excluded with a scope and a rationale. conformance/qualify.mjs reads a selection with the checker's own assessment and refuses it while any required claim cannot be made.

purpose.description: What the qualification is for: a release set, a declaration, a pilot.

releaseSet.description: The release set this selection qualifies, when there is one; it must exist under release/ and not be superseded.

id.description: A claim identifier the ledger carries.

kind.description: component: one role or profile of this implementation. system: a whole-system scope, held to every row carrying its profile. draft-compatibility: alignment with a draft text, never conformity. operation: a deployed service's behaviour, needing operational evidence. product: a product category's data or legal qualification. governance: a process condition, such as version 1.0 readiness.

disposition.description: required: the qualification fails unless the claim can be made. withheld: named so it does not disappear, with the reason it is not required.

scope.description: outside-claim-scope: the row belongs to another instrument or scope. separately-claimed: the claim named in coveredBy requires it. deferred: left for later, which a component claim may say and a system or product claim may not.

coveredBy.description: The ledger claim that requires the row, for separately-claimed.
